مُخَلَّدٌ : see the paragraph next receding. ―
-b2- مُخَلَّدُونَ in the Kur [lvi. 17 and lxxvi. 19] means Always of the same age; never altering in age: (Fr:) or [endowed with perpetual vigour;] that never become decrepit: (K:) or that never exceed the fit age for service: (L, K:) ＝
-A2- or it means adorned with earrings: (L, K:) or, with bracelets; (AO, L, K;) accord. to the dial. of El-Yemen: (L:) or, with ornaments. (Zj.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
